transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. Can you start by telling me what's been bothering you or what brought you in to see me?

Hi. Um, well, honestly, what made me come in is I feel like the warm part of me just... shut off. I'll sit with my husband, or try to watch my shows after work, and I know I should feel comfort or even a little happy, but... there’s just nothing there right now.
How long have you been noticing this feeling of emotional numbness or inability to feel happiness or comfort?
It's been about three weeks now. It started right after... well, there was an accident at work. A pallet collapsed and badly injured my coworker. Ever since that happened, I've just felt this way.
Since the accident, have you been having any unwanted memories, flashbacks, or nightmares about what happened to your coworker?

Yeah, I have. Um, sometimes out of nowhere I’ll just... I'll see that pallet coming down again, or I'll hear the crash in my head. It happens a lot when a forklift beeps, or if somebody drops something in the warehouse. Whenever that happens, my stomach just turns.
Have you found yourself avoiding certain places, people, or situations—like parts of the warehouse or talking about the accident—because they remind you of what happened?

No, I haven't really done that. I mean, I still go to work, and I still walk through the same parts of the warehouse. I haven't tried to avoid talking about it either, not on purpose anyway. It's just... I'm still doing all the normal things, I just feel empty while I'm doing them.
Since the accident, have you noticed feeling more on edge or easily startled than usual, or having trouble falling or staying asleep?

Yeah, my sleep has been pretty bad. Most nights I'll lie there completely exhausted after my late shift, but... every time I start to finally drift off, I just jerk awake. I keep thinking I hear pallets shifting or falling. And even if I do manage to get some sleep, I wake up feeling like I never really rested at all.
You mentioned this started about three weeks ago—counting from the day of the accident to today, has it been more or less than a full month since your symptoms began?
It's been less than a month. Yeah, it's been about three weeks... just ever since the pallet collapsed and hurt my coworker. That's when all this started.
